subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Everyone was shocked to see the old man upset and **__unkempt__**.
solution: The correct answer is** "messy and untidy."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Upset and unkempt"** means emotionally distressed and disheveled in appearance. (भावनात्मक रूप से व्यथित और दिखने में अस्त-व्यस्त) • **"Messy and untidy"** is a suitable replacement as it conveys the same meaning. • The word **"unkempt" **specifically refers to someone's appearance ((बाल या आम शकल-सूरत) अस्‍त व्‍यस्‍त, उपेक्षित; मैला-कुचैला), so it is important to choose an option that reflects this. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "up and doing"**, means active and busy, which does not fit the context of the sentence. (सक्रिय और व्यस्त) • **Option 3, "proud and useless"**, is a contradictory phrase and does not make sense in this context. (घमंडी और बेकार) • **Option 4, "violent and rigorous"**, implies a negative and aggressive behavior, which is not mentioned in the sentence. (हिंसक और कठोर) 35:Tbf3, The correct answer is** "Sky."**
